project: Stylish Profile — Pujan's GitHub profile page
notes: Live join/continue order fills roles; the seed list is a hint only. Boss seat is a lease in minutes (default 30, range 15-120); the watchdog is agent-less at ~10 minutes and is not failover. After a vacancy the GitHub-canonical claim_queue is FIFO and a returning old boss rejoins at the end. FULL PCM + FULL CGM 0.5.7 required — a slim subset is an incomplete install.

role_fill.notes: First continuer becomes decision boss; next becomes coder1; next becomes coder2.

agents.notes: Seed hint for an empty room; live join order wins when filling seats.

as_of_history.notes: Initial lease holder for the hotload. Append on failover; never rewrite.

watchdog.notes: AGENT-LESS. Cron or script only. No LLM, no peer agent. Watchdog is liveness and nudge only; it never appoints a boss.

pcm.notes: Full PCM for adopters: continuity and checkpoints, plus GitHub-owned progression. Not the proposal or ACCEPT layer. Pin the commit; do not follow moving main. Do not vendor PCM source.

routing.readme_product_entry: writing-direction (MUST load; scan-first selective bold; do not apply HSW bold restraints)
routing.pr_issue_docs_commits: human-sounding-writing / hsw (MUST load for PR and issue titles and bodies, non-README docs, commit subjects)
routing.html_reports_compare_appendable: human-sounding-writing / hsw (MUST; default ON; no per-report opt-in)
routing.generated_artifact_filenames: human-output-naming / hon (MUST; basenames and filename legends)
routing.contract: docs/writing-routing.json plus docs/ACS_VERIFY.md; acs_prompt_inject applies after VALID

cgm.notes: Full CGM 0.5.7: all eight modules including human-output-naming. Not HSW plus writing-direction only. Pin the commit; validate with scripts/validate_content_system.py against the target adapter; then apply acs_prompt_inject. Do not vendor CGM source.

ticket_links.notes: Parent and child notes only; no DAG engine. The owning leaf issue for the current task is https://github.com/Pukujan/stylish-profile/issues/1.
